facts.text: Automat sandwiches -- ham and cheese out of the little glass doors
facts.why: No Automat shows in the transcript, plot or a follow-up search. Joe and Ratso are shown stealing food when money is short.
facts.fix: Automat sandwiches -- the food Joe and Ratso steal when the money runs out

facts.text: Condemned building franks and beans -- all they could afford in the squat
facts.why: Critics describe the film's world of ketchup, beans and canned heat in the condemned squat, but nothing opened names franks.
facts.fix: Condemned building franks and beans -- beans heated over canned heat in the squat

vibe.verdict: A tidy bus station counter, but the pastel look feels nothing like the grimy film and the cowboy is missing.
missing: 'I'm walkin' here!' (the taxi on the street)
Joe's cowboy hat and boots (the whole film)
The X on the condemned windows (the squat)
Rico asking not to be called Ratso (the bus)
ideas: Swap 'Texas hamburger' for 'Cowboy Hamburger, Texas style', with a boot stamp.

Add 'I'm walkin' here!' as a house line in place of 'Open all night.'
